policy: VEX-style decisions for vulnerability matches: status not_affected (with justification), affected, fixed (with the Qt release or backport that carries the fix) or under_investigation. A Chrome version range does not account for Qt backports, so each match is triaged here. method records how a decision was reached: backport-commit, source-inspection or patch-level.

No backport commit exists. To be confirmed by running the upstream regression test regress-crbug-542403045.js against the shipped engine.
